description: The same failed OPEN as case06 but reporting the VSAM extended status '92', which drives the OTHER arm of 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS at :162-168 - the one taken when IO-STAT1 = '9'. That arm is genuine byte arithmetic and is the most easily mistranslated paragraph in the program: IO-STAT1 is moved to IO-STATUS-04(1:1), TWO-BYTES-BINARY is zeroed, IO-STAT2 is deposited into TWO-BYTES-RIGHT through the REDEFINES at :54-56, and the resulting unsigned value fills IO-STATUS-0403 PIC 999. The second byte here is '2', whose code point is 50, so the image is 9050 and NOT 0092. A translation that formatted the two characters directly would emit 0092 and this case is what says so.
